sentences.text: If a company laptop is lost or stolen, you must report it within 2 hours of noticing, by email to security@lumenrobotics.example or through the 24 hour security hotline.
You should also follow the security policy procedure and inform your manager.
A replacement for a stolen laptop needs the approval of your director, who will usually ask for the police report number before ordering.
Reporting late is treated as a policy violation, and the security team will lock and wipe the device remotely after the report.
